description: Three independent implementations of clamp, generated by Codex, Claude, and Antigravity. Each passes the same boundary and invalid-input checks.

tasks.prompt: Write Python function clamp(value, low, high): bound value to the closed interval [low, high], preserving values inside it. Raise ValueError when low > high. Support negative numbers and floats. No imports needed.
